description: Spawns the planning agent (/createplan). It scopes a new phased, agent-executable plan doc with you and writes it to planning/ in the plan-doc family shape (build-order table, per-phase Goal/Files/Tests/Exit gate). It does not implement the plan; activate it afterwards with Set as current.

fields.description: PascalCase stem ending in PLAN; the doc lands at planning/<name>.md.
fields.label: Plan name

fields.description: flat = one orchestrator drives every phase (the norm). large = phases are grouped into sections, and /execute-plan-phases gives each section its own orchestrator; needs 3+ sections of at most 5 phases each, so only pick it for work one orchestrator's context cannot hold.
fields.label: Plan scale

title: Create a New Plan
